international.title: Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid
international.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was one of FBI’s most wanted fugitives and evaded capture for more than a decade The Mexican military captured one of the FBI’s top 10 most wanted fugitives during a special forces raid in the Mexican state of Sinaloa on Friday night. Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro”, was arrested along with two other alleged leaders of his gang after a gun battle that sparked widespread panic in the city of Guasave.
